source.name: Kentucky Geological Survey, oil and gas well shapefile (KYOG, monthly)

notes: USGS Kentucky rows carry Kentucky permit numbers (primary_identifier_type KYPermit), joined to KGS_Permit. KGS records the operator at completion (Org_Oper) and the completion result (Org_Result: OIL, GAS, D&A...), not current operator or status, so the operator may not be the last one and active wells can't be identified. The download is a zipped shapefile: convert with ogr2ogr -f CSV -t_srs EPSG:4326 -lco GEOMETRY=AS_XY (the fetch workflow does this) and pass it with --state-file KY=...
